headline: Court freezes assets of Yardley Logistics amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Yardley Logistics after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.

headline: Yardley Logistics wins quality award from industry association
body: Yardley Logistics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Yardley Logistics appoints new regional sales director
body: Yardley Logistics announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Data breach at Yardley Logistics exposes customer records
body: Yardley Logistics disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.

headline: Labor union calls strike at Yardley Logistics Monterrey facility
body: Workers at the Monterrey facility of Yardley Logistics voted to strike over pay and safety conditions. Production at the site may be disrupted.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Yardley Logistics labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Yardley Logistics. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.

headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Yardley Logistics, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Yardley Logistics have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.
